meta.scope: Iran Batch 1 — Phase 0/1 foundations under locked expanded node definition. Statistical system (SCI), population, national accounts, prices, central bank anchors. Population ~87–93 million range.

candidates.title: Statistical Centre of Iran (SCI) institutional core
candidates.description: Primary national statistical office responsible for censuses, surveys, national accounts, prices, labour, demographic and multi-domain socio-economic statistics.
candidates.notes: Foundational institutional node for the Iranian statistical system.

candidates.title: Population census and estimates
candidates.description: Official population census and subsequent estimates. Population is in the high-80s to low-90s millions range in recent reports; urbanisation is advanced and the age structure is shifting toward aging.
candidates.notes: Core demographic node. Population ~87–93 million depending on source and reference year.

candidates.title: National Accounts of Iran (GDP)
candidates.publisher: Statistical Centre of Iran / Central Bank related
candidates.description: Official national accounts (GDP by industry and expenditure). Central macro-output series for an oil-and-gas-influenced, sanctions-affected economy.

candidates.title: Consumer Price Index and inflation statistics
candidates.description: Monthly CPI and inflation rates. Iran has experienced prolonged high inflation; the CPI series is a critical high-frequency price and welfare signal.
candidates.notes: Core high-frequency price node. High inflation environment gives this series elevated centrality.

candidates.title: Central Bank of the Islamic Republic of Iran institutional and reporting core
candidates.description: Central bank responsible for monetary policy, foreign-exchange management, banking supervision and key macro-financial and external statistics. Publishes monetary, banking, exchange-rate and related series.

candidates.title: Balance of Payments and external accounts
candidates.description: BOP and external-sector statistics. Strongly influenced by oil and gas exports, sanctions regimes, and non-oil export performance.

candidates.title: Iran foundational statistical-system meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from SCI and CBI sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding the SCI institutional core, population, national accounts, CPI, CBI institutional role and BOP into the opening foundation layer for Iranian research.
referenced_by: All detailed nodes in this batch
candidates.notes: Opening integrating node for Iranian research.
